title: The Prayag Group Chit Fund Scam
dek: A Kolkata-based group allegedly collected ₹2,800 crore from depositors through monthly-income schemes and club memberships that turned out to be another Bengal chit fund in the Saradha mould.

heroStat.label: allegedly collected from depositors through the group's schemes

promise.quote: Deposits collected by Prayag Group through its monthly income schemes, redeemable preference shares, and club membership certificates will be invested and repaid as promised.
promise.madeBy: Prayag Group of companies, promoted by Basudeb Bagchi and his son Avik Bagchi
promise.role: Private group operating deposit-collection schemes in and around Kolkata
promise.context: Like Saradha and Rose Valley, Prayag Group ran deposit-collection schemes in West Bengal that regulators and investigators later characterised as unregistered, unsustainable collective investment schemes.

target.description: Deposits collected and managed as a properly registered scheme, with funds genuinely invested and returns paid as promised.

reality.description: The Enforcement Directorate arrested Basudeb Bagchi and his son Avik Bagchi, promoters of Prayag Group, in November 2024, alleging the group had collected roughly ₹2,800 crore from the public through false high-return schemes. Premises in both Kolkata and Mumbai were raided as part of the money-laundering investigation.

gap.metricLabel: Amount allegedly collected vs. amount confirmed recovered for depositors
gap.note: This investigation did not find a confirmed asset-recovery or depositor-repayment figure and reports it as unestablished rather than assuming it to be zero.

timeline.label: Scheme collection begins drawing scrutiny
timeline.detail: Around the same period as the Saradha and Rose Valley collapses, Prayag Group's schemes come under similar suspicion.

timeline.label: ED raids Kolkata and Mumbai
timeline.detail: The agency searches premises linked to the Bagchis and associates.

timeline.label: Father and son arrested
timeline.detail: The ED arrests Basudeb Bagchi and Avik Bagchi.

legalStatus.summary: This is a stub entry. Both principal accused were arrested in November 2024; this investigation has not yet traced the case to a bail decision or trial verdict.

keyIndividuals.name: Basudeb Bagchi
keyIndividuals.outcome: Arrested by the ED, November 2024. This investigation has not confirmed a subsequent bail decision or trial verdict.

keyIndividuals.name: Avik Bagchi
keyIndividuals.role: Promoter, Prayag Group; son of Basudeb Bagchi
keyIndividuals.outcome: Arrested by the ED, November 2024, alongside his father. No confirmed subsequent status.

verdict.summary: Preliminary verdict, pending fuller research: the arrests and the alleged scale of the scheme are documented. This investigation has not yet established the case's current status or any recovery for depositors.
verdict.reasoning: This entry was added to establish the case's place in the site's timeline and its headline facts. It has not yet received the same depth of research as the site's fully developed cases.
